description: This file implements a logging wrapper for klog, providing a simplified logger interface with methods for initialization, logging at different levels, adding context with names and values, and managing call depth. It defines the 'klogger' class and related functions.

classes.name: klogger
classes.description: A struct implementing a subset of logr.LogSink with additional context management features.

methods.name: NewKlogr
methods.description: Returns a logger identical to klogr.NewWithOptions(klogr.FormatKlog), passing through to klog with a simpler implementation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the logger with runtime info, adjusting call depth.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an informational message at a specified level with key-value pairs.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled at a specified level.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs an error message with associated error and key-value pairs.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Returns a new logger with the specified name appended, using '.' as separator.

methods.name: WithValues
methods.description: Returns a new logger with additional key-value pairs.

methods.name: WithCallDepth
methods.description: Returns a new logger with increased call depth for accurate call site reporting.
